legal.terms.meta_description: Manna Terms of Service: subscription plans, 14-day trial, lead collection rules, acceptable use, billing, and termination. Big agency data, little guy money.
legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
legal.terms.s_service_first: Manna is a marketing command center provided by D2RM: lead collection from public sources, email campaign analytics, influencer outreach tracking, and goal dashboards.
legal.terms.s_billing_intro: Plans are billed monthly in advance:
legal.terms.plan_starter_item: Starter — $29.99/month (special offer; regular $49.99/month): 2 projects, 5,000 emails per month.
legal.terms.plan_pro_item: Pro — $69.99/month (special offer; regular $89.99/month): 10 projects, 20,000 emails per month.
legal.terms.s_trial_first: New accounts receive a 14-day trial including the full dashboard and lead collection.
legal.terms.s_use_first: You agree not to: send spam or unsolicited bulk email (you must comply with CAN-SPAM and all applicable anti-spam laws, including maintaining consent records and honoring unsubscribes); use collected lead data unlawfully; abuse the collection tools against rate limits or terms of third-party sites; resell or redistribute the service; or attempt to disrupt the platform.
legal.terms.s_leads_first: Lead collection gathers publicly available business contact information (public YouTube channel pages, public websites) at your direction.
legal.terms.s_termination_first: Either party may terminate at any time.
legal.terms.s_liability_first: The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind.
legal.terms.s_changes_first: We may update these terms; material changes will be communicated in-app or by email.
legal.privacy.meta_description: Manna Privacy Policy: what account and usage data we collect, how lead data from public sources is handled, data security, cookies, and your rights. We never sell data.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.s_collect_first: Account data: name, email, company name, and plan details you provide at signup.
legal.privacy.s_use_first: To operate the service: run your account, collect and display your leads, track your campaigns, prevent fraud, and improve the product.
legal.privacy.s_retention_first: We keep your account and lead data while your account is active.
legal.privacy.s_rights_first: Request a copy of your data or deletion of your account at any time:
legal.privacy.s_cookies_first: We use a single httpOnly, SameSite session cookie (d2rm_session) to keep you logged in.
legal.privacy.s_children_first: Manna is a business product and is not directed at children under 13.
